name: CORS
summary: Cross-origin access, denied by default. Allowed origins come from the CORS_ORIGINS variable.

credentials.description: Allow cookies and credentials on cross-origin requests

features: - **CORS**: cross-origin requests are denied unless the origin is listed in `CORS_ORIGINS`

env.description: Comma-separated list of allowed browser origins, for example https://app.example.com (empty denies all)
